name: dtr
title: Pulse PRG/DTR
description: lmesh-local board-specific GPIO0/PRG pulse for an optional number of milliseconds (default 120, maximum 10000). Normal firmware console wake uses UART RX. This record is not sent to firmware.

name: rst
title: Reset device
description: lmesh-local control: pulse the board reset line and return it to run mode. This record is not sent to firmware.

name: status
title: Status
description: Compact device health, power, memory, radio, queue, and battery summary.

name: xstatus
title: Extended status
description: Extended device status and runtime counters; reset=true clears counters.

name: stats
title: Statistics
description: Packet, task, wake, runtime, and battery counters.

name: logs
title: Logs
description: Read or clear bounded structured event history.

name: messages
title: Messages
description: Read the bounded packet buffer with transport, direction, pull, and acknowledgement filters.

name: local_messages
title: Local messages
description: Read packets addressed to the local device.

name: test
title: Radio test
description: Start or inspect non-blocking discovery and ping tests.

name: wifi
title: Wi-Fi
description: Configure raw/custom NAN, STA/AP experiments, scans, frame transmission, and Wi-Fi counters.

name: nan
title: Raw NAN
description: Control and inspect low-power raw/custom NAN discovery windows and queued traffic.

name: ble
title: BLE companion
description: Control BLE GATT, pairing, advertising, notifications, bonds, and companion state.

name: lora
title: LoRa
description: Configure and inspect LoRa hardware, modulation, receive, CAD, and counters.

name: radio
title: Bounded GFSK radio
description: Run an explicit SX127x GFSK send, discovery sweep, or rendezvous listen session; normal LoRa receive is restored afterwards.

name: lorasend
title: LoRa send
description: Send one raw, Meshtastic, or MeshCore LoRa packet.

name: loralisten
title: LoRa listen
description: Open a bounded synchronous LoRa receive window.

name: loradump
title: LoRa register dump
description: Dump LoRa radio registers and status.

name: loraprobe
title: LoRa probe
description: Probe LoRa chip and wiring candidates and optionally persist the result.

name: sleep
title: Sleep
description: Inspect sleep state or run bounded light/deep-sleep profiles with timer recovery.

name: mode
title: Operating mode
description: Inspect or switch infra/companion mode. In infra, active=true enables a runtime-only powered gateway/transfer radio state until active=false; active_ms=N creates a bounded 1000..300000 ms active session before returning to raw-NAN duty sleep.

name: power
title: Power management
description: Inspect CPU/PM state or configure dfs, perf, low, and automatic-light-sleep profiles.

name: battery
title: Battery
description: Read battery voltage and configure ADC/divider/control-pin calibration.

name: adcprobe
title: ADC probe
description: Sample one or more ADC pins at a bounded or continuous interval.

name: namespace
title: NVS namespace
description: Legacy debug alias for NVS namespace selection.

name: set
title: NVS set
description: Legacy debug alias for setting one NVS value.

name: get
title: NVS get
description: Legacy debug alias for reading one NVS value.

name: list
title: NVS list
description: Legacy debug alias for listing explicitly stored NVS values.

name: rgbled
title: RGB LED
description: Control a WS2812/SK6812-compatible status LED.

name: gpio
title: GPIO
description: Read or configure a GPIO for hardware diagnostics.

name: i2cconfig
title: I2C configuration
description: Configure and optionally persist the I2C port, pins, and frequency.

name: i2cprobe
title: I2C probe
description: Probe candidate I2C pin combinations.

name: i2cdetect
title: I2C detect
description: Scan the configured I2C bus for devices.

name: i2cget
title: I2C read
description: Read a register from one I2C device.

name: i2cset
title: I2C write
description: Write a register on one I2C device.

name: i2cdump
title: I2C dump
description: Dump a bounded register range from one I2C device.

name: button
title: Button
description: Inspect or configure PRG/button GPIO handling and counters.

name: nvs
title: Persistent settings
description: Select namespaces and get, set, list, or inspect NVS settings and usage.
